High-level overview of Unicity, the Autonomous Agentic Internet, and the protocol architecture. Start here for the motivation, system model, tokenomics, and how the network components fit together.

Download

  • Latest PDF: Unicity.pdf

Unicity Paper Map

  • Unicity Whitepaper (PDF) - protocol overview, tokenomics, and network architecture.
  • Unicity Yellowpaper (PDF) - low-level protocol specification, including consensus-layer engineering details, data availability, and aggregation shard operation.
  • Unicity Infrastructure: the Aggregation Layer / Unicity Bluepaper (PDF) - aggregation-layer design, sharded SMT commitments, inclusion and non-inclusion proofs, and the ZK consistency proof model.
  • Unicity Execution Layer (PDF) - off-chain transaction execution, service-side privacy, user-wallet privacy, and formal security proofs.
  • Unicity: Predicates and Atomic Swaps (PDF) - programmable spending conditions ("smart contracts") and an usage example, trustless atomic swaps.

# The Unicity Whitepaper

High-level overview of Unicity, the Autonomous Agentic Internet, and the
protocol architecture. Start here for the motivation, system model,
tokenomics, and how the network components fit together.

## Download

- Latest PDF:
  [Unicity.pdf](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/whitepaper/releases/download/latest/Unicity.pdf)
- Source repository:
  [github.com/unicitynetwork/whitepaper](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/whitepaper/)

## Unicity Paper Map

- [Unicity Whitepaper](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/whitepaper)
  ([PDF](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/whitepaper/releases/download/latest/Unicity.pdf)) -
  protocol overview, tokenomics, and network architecture.
- [Unicity Yellowpaper](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/unicity-yellowpaper-tex)
  ([PDF](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/unicity-yellowpaper-tex/releases/download/latest/unicity-yellowpaper.pdf)) -
  low-level protocol specification, including consensus-layer engineering
  details, data availability, and aggregation shard operation.
- [Unicity Infrastructure: the Aggregation Layer / Unicity Bluepaper](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/aggr-layer-paper)
  ([PDF](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/aggr-layer-paper/releases/download/latest/aggregation-layer.pdf)) -
  aggregation-layer design, sharded SMT commitments, inclusion and
  non-inclusion proofs, and the ZK consistency proof model.
- [Unicity Execution Layer](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/execution-model-tex)
  ([PDF](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/execution-model-tex/releases/download/latest/unicity-execution-layer.pdf)) -
  off-chain transaction execution, service-side privacy, user-wallet
  privacy, and formal security proofs.
- [Unicity: Predicates and Atomic Swaps](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/unicity-predicates-tex)
  ([PDF](https://github.com/unicitynetwork/unicity-predicates-tex/releases/download/latest/unicity-predicates.pdf)) -
  programmable spending conditions ("smart contracts") and an usage example, trustless atomic swaps.

aiSummary.oneLiner: The comprehensive technical whitepaper outlining Unicity, the Autonomous Agentic Internet, and its protocol architecture.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository houses the foundational documentation for the Unicity Network, detailing its motivation, system model, and tokenomics. It serves as the primary source of truth for the network's high-level architecture and how its various components fit together. The whitepaper is part of a broader suite of technical papers, including yellow, blue, and execution layer papers, that collectively specify the protocol from consensus to execution. It provides the crucial theoretical and technical background necessary to understand or contribute to the Unicity ecosystem. The documentation outlines core concepts and integration details necessary for deploying secure, decentralized applications on the network.
keyFeatures: Protocol overview: Details the high-level architecture, tokenomics, and network components of the Unicity network.
Companion documentation links: Provides direct access to related technical papers covering sharding, zero-knowledge proofs, and execution.
PDF releases: Offers pre-compiled, versioned PDF downloads of the whitepaper for offline reading and distribution.
Consensus mechanisms: Outlines the specific cryptographic and systemic rules governing the decentralized network.
Tokenomic models: Explains the economic incentives, token distribution, and financial structure powering the ecosystem.
Conceptual Outlines: Details the cryptographic mechanisms and protocol rules underpinning the network.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This documentation is designed for blockchain developers, cryptographic researchers, technical analysts, and active members of the Unicity Network community. Readers should possess a strong foundational understanding of decentralized systems, zero-knowledge proofs, and distributed ledger technology.
